title: More routes. One simple swap.
summary: Titan joins Oren’s swap router, adding another way to find routes for tokenized stocks on Solana. Watch the idea in ten seconds.

items.title: Titan route comparison
items.description: When enabled, Oren compares Titan and Jupiter quotes after estimated network fees to choose the better available route.

items.title: Your minimum stays protected
items.description: A refreshed route or fallback must meet the minimum you reviewed. If it cannot, Oren asks for a new quote.

items.title: A fallback when needed
items.description: If Titan is unavailable, Oren can use Jupiter while keeping the same minimum-received protection.

video.label: Oren powered by Titan, a ten-second route comparison film
video.caption: Titan routing is available where enabled. Sample quote shown; prices can change.
